tools.name: vara_run_scan
tools.description: Execute a full Real Vara scan using the operational dual-track, multi-timescale pipeline. This tool changes Vara runtime state.

tools.name: vara_list_scans
tools.description: List historical Vara scan metadata from the local archive.

tools.name: vara_get_scan
tools.description: Retrieve a complete historical VaraScanReport by scan_id or short prefix.

tools.name: vara_query_signals
tools.description: Query the committed Vault corpus and optionally the current Veil hold.

tools.name: vara_get_veil_state
tools.description: Inspect current Veil hold entries and trajectories.

tools.name: vara_generate_fir
tools.description: Generate an Operator-Tier or lightweight Field Intel Report from a scan_id.
